locationComparison.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
notes: Cave horrors can be safespotted using mushrooms, stalagmites, and boulders throughout the cave.
A cannon can be placed in the cave, including the documented safespot cannon placement near 3785,9460.

taskNotes: Cave horrors require 58 Slayer, 85 combat, and completion of Cabin Fever.
Cave horrors are found exclusively in Mos Le'Harmless Cave.
A witchwood icon blocks their special attack when fighting at melee distance; without it, the special always deals 10% of the player's base Hitpoints level, rounded down.
Protect from Melee completely mitigates the special attack and their magic-based melee damage.
A light source is required unless a Fire of eternal light is lit in the cave.
Cave horrors attack with magic-based melee: Protect from Melee blocks damage, while high magic defence helps when not praying.
They have fairly low Hitpoints and are spread apart, so fast-firing Ranged weapons such as Toxic blowpipe, Magic shortbow (i), Hunter's sunlight crossbow, and Karil's crossbow are generally best.
Melee can be used with high Prayer bonus gear such as Proselyte armour and Protect from Melee, or with dragonhide-style magic defence and a witchwood icon when conserving prayer.
A dwarf multicannon can speed up kills, and one cannon safespot placement allows monsters targeted by the cannon to get stuck on the wall.
Safespots are available by the entrance, swamp, mushrooms, stalagmites, boulders, and other obstacles in the cave.
Bones to Peaches or tablets can extend melee trips by converting big bones into food.
Herb sack, seed box, log basket or plank sack, reagent pouch, Bonecrusher, and Soul bearer are useful because of common drops.
Cave horrors are often killed for the black mask drop and hard clue scrolls.
Cave horrors now have a 30% elemental weakness to fire spells.
recommendedMethod: Use fast ranged weapons with safespots or cannon support for low-damage tasks. Use Protect from Melee with prayer gear for melee kills, or wear a witchwood icon with high magic-defence armour when conserving prayer.
